title: Molecular mechanisms of phytochemicals from(Roxb.) DC. against hepatocellular carcinoma: insights from network pharmacology, molecular docking, and bioinformatics.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is an aggressive malignancy with limited therapies. We explored the anti-HCC mechanisms of(Roxb.) DC. via network pharmacology, bioinformatics and molecular docking. We identified its active components, targets and HCC-related key genes by differential expression analysis.
